summary: StatTiles wraps as the sheet's new Narrow row section draws it. The row is a container: one line only while each tile gets 280px (four from 1120px, three from 840px), else two by two with the hairlines following the wrap and a third tile spanning the second row. Each tile is a container too: under 220px of content its sparkline drops 16px under the change line. Replaces tiles shrinking side by side until their text wrapped.
